# The landing pad: an octagonal deck 2.2 m across, its top 0.5 m up, a pale deck top with metal
# sides, four struts down into the ground (to -0.5), two unlit lamps at its ends. Origin on the ground
# under its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Metal --base-color 0.306 0.286 0.373 --no-slot
material new Deck --base-color 0.600 0.459 0.467 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.965 0.839 0.741 --no-slot
material new Lamp --base-color 0.965 0.839 0.741 --no-slot --emission 0.965 0.839 0.741
add mesh cylinder --name Deck --vertices 8 --radius 1.19 --depth 0.28 --location 0 0 0.36 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Deck
add mesh cylinder --name Stripe --vertices 8 --radius 1.21 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0.33 --rotation 0 0 22.5
material assign Stripe
add mesh cube --name StrutA --size 1 --location -0.7 -0.45 0.0
scale 0.14 0.14 0.9
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name StrutB --size 1 --location 0.7 -0.45 0.0
scale 0.14 0.14 0.9
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name StrutC --size 1 --location -0.7 0.45 0.0
scale 0.14 0.14 0.9
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name StrutD --size 1 --location 0.7 0.45 0.0
scale 0.14 0.14 0.9
apply --scale
select StrutA StrutB StrutC StrutD
material assign Metal
add mesh cube --name LampA --size 0.17 --location -1.08 0 0.58
add mesh cube --name LampB --size 0.17 --location 1.08 0 0.58
select LampA LampB
material assign Lamp
select all
shade flat
export pad.glb
